This Appeal, Coming On For Orders, This Day, The
Court Delivered The Following:
 Judgment
Learned advocate for the appellant submits that the statutory deposit has to be made in the appeal and inspite of reminders, the appellant is not coming forward to deposit the same.
He further submits that he has no instruction to go on with the matter.
For that reason, appeal stands dismissed for non- prosecution.
